decisions.reason: The yogurt-on-fruit-puree product sits squarely in Söbbeke's core organic yogurt know-how, and its eathealthy Award gives an early market signal the firm can read and build on.
The flavoured organic Abendbrotkäse extends the firm's existing cheese competence with a simple recipe variation that the firm can easily assimilate and adjust, and it was promoted on the home page.
A semi-hard cheese wheel builds on the established cheese-making knowledge of the organic dairy, though it gets only a plain website mention and no reported results.
The spicy cheese is a related variant the firm can handle with its existing skills, but with no result signal reported it is a candidate for range pruning.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounds off the new French-style soft cheese line and draws on soft-cheese know-how the firm is actively building.

A washed-rind soft cheese needs more specialised ripening knowledge, which makes early results harder to interpret and raises the risk, but it fits the new soft cheese line and deserves more learning time.
